title: Course syllabus

## Course direction

The course combines computational economic methods with practical research workflows. Lectures move through the core methods earlier, leaving a closing block for recent computational literature using machine-learning tools. Labs develop students' use of LLM agents for research, alongside Git and other regular tools. Python supports the computational work.

## Topic decks and weekly sessions

The schedule is organized by week, while slides are organized by topic. A topic may occupy part of a week or continue across several weeks. The provisional schedule below covers core methods followed by literature sessions in Weeks 11–13.

## Weekly homework

Weekly pages will provide readings, exercises, submission instructions, and deadlines.

## Assessment

The replication project accounts for 100% of the grade. Work in teams of 2–3 and replicate as many papers as there are team members.

See the [project guide](project.qmd) and [reading resources](references.qmd).
